decisionLog.decision: Chats becomes a project-scoped destination separate from Changes. Reuse the original session and existing lessmess-scaffold flow for promotion so history is preserved. Confirmed promotion authorizes scaffolding and planning only; implementation still needs explicit user approval.

Keep creation actions section-local: New chat appears only inside Chats and New change session only inside Changes. Replace the Settings navigation text with an accessible gear icon; service-management return navigation goes to Chats without spawning a conversation.

tasks.title: Model standalone chat metadata and compatible listing
tasks.notes: Server tests and targeted race checks passed for legacy/fork compatibility, helper and bound-session filtering, prefixed exact-session links, live activity/offline fallback, and atomic metadata/title/mapping rollback.

tasks.title: Add the dedicated Chats page and navigation
tasks.notes: go test ./internal/server ./web passed. Renderer tests cover Chats/Changes separation, escaped titles, exact-session links, location/navigation, retained planning entry, and single-project/hub-prefixed paths. go test ./internal/server ./web, go vet ./..., the CGO_ENABLED=0 build, and git diff --check passed. Renderer regressions verify New chat only in Chats, New change session only in Changes, no shared-header creation action, accessible gear-only Settings navigation and active states, and non-spawning service-management return links with empty and hub-prefixed paths. Existing Chats navigation, naming, promotion, and browser-glue tests remain passing. Final go test ./... passed. Verified the rebuilt live service on port 9090: New chat appears only under Chats, New change session only under Changes, gear-only Settings navigation retains its accessible name and active state, and service management returns to Chats without spawning. Workflow validation reports no violations (existing documentation warnings remain). Right-aligned the Chats section New chat action with margin-left:auto, matching the Changes creation action. go test ./internal/server ./web, the CGO_ENABLED=0 rebuild, and git diff --check passed; a renderer regression pins the alignment rule. Restarted the approved direct-run service and verified that port 9090 serves the updated stylesheet.

tasks.title: Name chats once after the first real user message
tasks.notes: go test ./internal/opencode ./internal/server ./web passed. Tests cover advertised generation contract/authentication/model shape, first accepted input only, rejected input, readable fallback and file-only naming, custom titles, bounded Unicode titles, repeated inputs, and late generation after manual naming/binding/unlink.

tasks.title: Safely promote the same chat through existing scaffolding
tasks.notes: go test ./internal/server ./internal/opencode ./web passed. Promotion tests verify one admission per confirmation, attached scaffold skill, planning-only approval, same-session durable binding/title/instruction refresh, repeated/concurrent scaffold refusal, and unknown/helper/bound/busy/stale/invalid confirmation guards.

tasks.title: Add promotion controls and verify the complete chat lifecycle
tasks.notes: go vet ./..., go test ./..., targeted race tests for all new Chat/Promote/Generate paths, CGO_ENABLED=0 build, and git diff --check passed. Isolated headless Chrome verified desktop/mobile creation, first-message naming, confirmation focus/cancel, same-session promotion, retained unsent draft, Chats/Changes reclassification, no mobile overflow, and reload/resume. Broader race run exposed an unchanged TestWaitDoneRetriesTransportTimeout fixture race; that unrelated test was left untouched.
